using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public unsafe class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        // We will test that the logger.LogWarning call in the catch block is hit by causing an exception in ProcessPrimaryStream.
        // We will mock dependencies to cause an exception and verify the logger call.

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsWarningOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
            var appendOnlyFileMock = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>();
            var clusterManagerMock = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var currentConfig = new ClusterConfig { LocalNodeRole = NodeRole.REPLICA, LocalNodeId = "node1" };

            // Setup clusterProvider and nested properties
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.storeWrapper).Returns(storeWrapperMock.Object);
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.clusterManager).Returns(clusterManagerMock.Object);
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions { ReplicationOffsetMaxLag = 0, EnableFastCommit = false, FastAofTruncate = false });
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.replicationManager).Returns(new ReplicationManagerStub(false));
            clusterManagerMock.SetupGet(c => c.CurrentConfig).Returns(currentConfig);

            // Setup storeWrapper and appendOnlyFile
            storeWrapperMock.SetupGet(s => s.appendOnlyFile).Returns(appendOnlyFileMock.Object);
            storeWrapperMock.SetupGet(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(clusterProviderMock.Object.serverOptions);
            storeWrapperMock.SetupGet(s => s.DefaultDatabase).Returns(null);

            // Setup appendOnlyFile to throw on UnsafeEnqueueRaw to cause exception
            appendOnlyFileMock.Setup(a => a.TailAddress).Returns(100L);
            appendOnlyFileMock.Setup(a => a.UnsafeEnqueueRaw(It.IsAny<Span<byte>>(), It.IsAny<bool>())).Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Create ReplicationManager instance with injected mocks
            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerForTest(clusterProviderMock.Object, loggerMock.Object);

            // Prepare dummy record pointer and parameters
            byte[] recordData = new byte[10];
            fixed (byte* recordPtr = recordData)
            {
                // Act & Assert
                var ex = Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() =>
                    replicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(recordPtr, recordData.Length, 0, 100, 110));

                // Verify that logger.LogWarning was called with the exception and expected message
                loggerMock.Verify(
                    l => l.LogWarning(
                        It.Is<Exception>(e => e.Message == "Test exception"),
                        "An exception occurred at ReplicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream"),
                    Times.Once);
            }
        }

        // Stub classes and interfaces to allow testing

        private class ReplicationManagerForTest : ReplicationManager
        {
            public ReplicationManagerForTest(IClusterProvider clusterProvider, ILogger logger)
            {
                this.clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
                this.logger = logger;
                this.storeWrapper = clusterProvider.storeWrapper;
                this.activeReplay = new ActiveReplayStub();
                this.pageSizeBits = 12;
                this.ReplicationOffset = 100;
            }

            public new IClusterProvider clusterProvider;
            public new ILogger logger;
            public new IStoreWrapper storeWrapper;
            public new ActiveReplayStub activeReplay;
            public new int pageSizeBits;
            public new long ReplicationOffset;

            // Override Consume to do nothing
            protected override void Consume(byte* record, int recordLength, long currentAddress, long nextAddress, bool isProtected)
            {
                // no-op
            }

            // Override ThrottlePrimary to do nothing
            protected override void ThrottlePrimary()
            {
                // no-op
            }
        }

        private class ActiveReplayStub
        {
            public bool TryReadLock() => true;
            public void ReadUnlock() { }
        }

        private class ReplicationManagerStub
        {
            public ReplicationManagerStub(bool cannotStreamAOF)
            {
                CannotStreamAOF = cannotStreamAOF;
            }
            public bool CannotStreamAOF { get; }
        }

        // Interfaces to mock dependencies

        public interface IClusterProvider
        {
            IStoreWrapper storeWrapper { get; }
            IClusterManager clusterManager { get; }
            ServerOptions serverOptions { get; }
            ReplicationManagerStub replicationManager { get; }
        }

        public interface IStoreWrapper
        {
            IAppendOnlyFile appendOnlyFile { get; }
            ServerOptions serverOptions { get; }
            IDatabase DefaultDatabase { get; }
        }

        public interface IAppendOnlyFile
        {
            long TailAddress { get; }
            void UnsafeEnqueueRaw(Span<byte> data, bool noCommit);
            void SafeInitialize(long start, long end);
            IReplayIterator ScanSingle(long start, long end, bool scanUncommitted, bool recover, ILogger logger);
        }

        public interface IClusterManager
        {
            ClusterConfig CurrentConfig { get; }
        }

        public interface IDatabase
        {
            IVectorManager VectorManager { get; }
        }

        public interface IVectorManager
        {
            void WaitForVectorOperationsToComplete();
        }

        public interface IReplayIterator { }

        public class ServerOptions
        {
            public int ReplicationOffsetMaxLag { get; set; }
            public bool EnableFastCommit { get; set; }
            public bool FastAofTruncate { get; set; }
        }

        public class ClusterConfig
        {
            public NodeRole LocalNodeRole { get; set; }
            public string LocalNodeId { get; set; }
        }

        public enum NodeRole
        {
            REPLICA,
            PRIMARY
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public unsafe class ReplicationManagerLoggerTests
    {
        // We cannot instantiate ReplicationManager directly because it is internal sealed.
        // Instead, we test the logger call by invoking ProcessPrimaryStream via reflection and causing an exception inside.

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsWarningOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var assembly = typeof(Garnet.cluster.ReplicationManager).Assembly;
            var replicationManagerType = assembly.GetType("Garnet.cluster.ReplicationManager");
            Assert.NotNull(replicationManagerType);

            // Create mocks for ILogger and dependencies
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<object>(); // We cannot mock internal types easily, so we will skip deep mocking

            // Create an instance of ReplicationManager via reflection (using non-public constructor)
            var ctor = replicationManagerType.GetConstructor(
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic,
                null, Type.EmptyTypes, null);
            Assert.NotNull(ctor);
            var replicationManager = ctor.Invoke(null);

            // Set the private logger field to our mock logger
            var loggerField = replicationManagerType.GetField("logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            Assert.NotNull(loggerField);
            loggerField.SetValue(replicationManager, loggerMock.Object);

            // We will call ProcessPrimaryStream with parameters that cause an exception inside.
            // Since the method is public, we can invoke it.
            var method = replicationManagerType.GetMethod("ProcessPrimaryStream", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public);
            Assert.NotNull(method);

            // Prepare dummy record pointer
            byte[] recordData = new byte[10];
            fixed (byte* recordPtr = recordData)
            {
                // Act
                Exception caughtException = null;
                try
                {
                    method.Invoke(replicationManager, new object[] { (IntPtr)recordPtr, recordData.Length, 0L, 0L, 0L });
                }
                catch (System.Reflection.TargetInvocationException tie)
                {
                    caughtException = tie.InnerException;
                }

                // Assert
                Assert.NotNull(caughtException);
                // Verify that logger.LogWarning was called at least once with any exception and the expected message
                loggerMock.Verify(
                    l => l.LogWarning(
                        It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                        "An exception occurred at ReplicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream"),
                    Times.AtLeastOnce);
            }
        }
    }
}
